youtube_description: When using a compass with a map, align the north arrow with the north on the map, then turn the direction arrow to the direction of travel. Visually look at the landscape for markers to travel in as straight of a line as possible. Happy Hiking!! Remember to please click through to Hikers Dream as this is part of a class.
